verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published pricing page, plan tiers, seat types, or feature-gating matrix for Claude Design. The only nearby items are an admin toggle saying Claude Design is off by default for Enterprise organizations and community remarks about a separate usage bar and subscription access. Neither documents plan pricing, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, published plan pricing makes seat types, tiers, and AI-feature gating clear before procurement
